## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`pnpm test`, `pnpm test:e2e` if UI)
- [ ] `pnpm lint` and `pnpm typecheck` clean
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or real CVs in code, fixtures, or logs
- [ ] Migrations generated and committed (if schema changed)
- [ ] The ground rules in CONTRIBUTING.md still hold (approval before applying, truthful CVs, local and private)
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or configuration changed
